problems.title: Consistency Distillation & Pseudo-Huber Loss
problems.titleZh: 一致性蒸馏（Consistency Distillation）与伪 Huber 损失
problems.hint: Detach the teacher before forming the squared Euclidean distance, apply the pseudo-Huber transform per sample, then optionally weight before averaging.
problems.hintZh: 计算平方欧氏距离前先分离教师输出，逐样本应用伪 Huber 变换，再选择性加权并取平均。
problems.descriptionEn: Compute consistency distillation between student and detached teacher outputs of shape (B,D). Return the mean optionally weighted objective and the unweighted per-sample pseudo-Huber values.
problems.descriptionZh: 计算形状为 (B,D) 的学生输出与已分离教师输出之间的一致性蒸馏损失。返回可选加权目标的均值和未加权的逐样本伪 Huber 值。
problems.theoryEn: The pseudo-Huber form sqrt(||delta||^2+c^2)-c is smooth near zero and grows approximately linearly for large residuals. Stop-gradient makes the teacher a fixed regression target.
problems.theoryZh: 伪 Huber 形式 sqrt(||delta||^2+c^2)-c 在零点附近光滑，对大残差近似线性增长。停止梯度使教师成为固定回归目标。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
student - stopgrad(teacher) -> squared L2 -> pseudo-Huber -> weight -> mean
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
学生 - stopgrad(教师) -> 平方 L2 -> 伪 Huber -> 加权 -> 均值
```

problems.title: IPO (Identity Preference) & KTO (Prospect Theory) Alignment Losses
problems.titleZh: IPO 与 KTO 偏好对齐损失
problems.hint: Detach both reference-model log-probabilities. Build IPO from the chosen-minus-rejected log-ratio margin, and detach the batch-average KTO reference point before applying sigmoids.
problems.hintZh: 分离两个参考模型对数概率；用选中减拒绝的对数比边际构造 IPO，并在 sigmoid 前分离 KTO 的批次平均参考点。
problems.descriptionEn: Compute IPO's squared preference-margin objective and KTO's prospect-theoretic desirable/undesirable objective from policy and reference sequence log-probabilities.
problems.descriptionZh: 根据策略与参考模型的序列对数概率，计算 IPO 平方偏好边际目标和 KTO 前景理论中的期望/非期望目标。
problems.theoryEn: IPO regresses the implicit reward gap toward a finite target instead of driving it unbounded. KTO evaluates desirable and undesirable samples relative to a detached reference point, reflecting asymmetric prospect-style value.
problems.theoryZh: IPO 将隐式奖励差回归到有限目标，而非无限推高。KTO 相对分离的参考点评估期望与非期望样本，体现非对称的前景价值。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
policy logp - stopgrad(reference logp) -> log ratios
ratios -> squared IPO margin
ratios -> stopgrad z0 -> desirable/undesirable sigmoids -> KTO
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
策略 logp - stopgrad(参考 logp) -> 对数比
对数比 -> IPO 平方边际
对数比 -> stopgrad z0 -> 期望/非期望 sigmoid -> KTO
```

tests.name: exact IPO and KTO formulas
tests.code:
import torch
pc=torch.tensor([-.2,-.6],dtype=torch.double); pr=torch.tensor([-1.,-.8],dtype=torch.double)
rc=torch.tensor([-.4,-.5],dtype=torch.double); rr=torch.tensor([-.7,-1.1],dtype=torch.double)
ipo,kto={fn}(pc,pr,rc,rr,tau=.25,beta_kto=.3)
rw=pc-rc.detach(); rl=pr-rr.detach()
ri=((rw-rl-1/(2*.25))**2).mean()
z=.5*(rw.detach().mean()+rl.detach().mean())
vd=torch.sigmoid(.3*(rw-z)); vu=torch.sigmoid(.3*(z-rl))
rk=(1-.5*(vd+vu)).mean()
assert torch.allclose(ipo,ri,atol=1e-12,rtol=1e-12)
assert torch.allclose(kto,rk,atol=1e-12,rtol=1e-12)

problems.title: KIVI Asymmetric KV Cache Quantization (Per-Channel K, Per-Token V)
problems.titleZh: KIVI 非对称 KV Cache 量化（按通道 K / 按 Token V）
problems.hint: Reduce K over sequence dimension 1 and V over channel dimension 2. Use each min as the affine offset and quantize into levels 0 through 2^n_bits-1.
problems.hintZh: K 沿序列维 1 归约，V 沿通道维 2 归约；以各自最小值为仿射偏移，量化到 0 至 2^n_bits-1。
problems.descriptionEn: Implement KIVI's asymmetric low-bit KV-cache quantization with per-channel key parameters and per-token value parameters.
problems.descriptionZh: 实现 KIVI 非对称低比特 KV 缓存量化：键按通道设置参数，值按 token 设置参数。
problems.theoryEn: Key outliers are structured by feature channel across positions, whereas value outliers are better localized per token. Using different quantization axes reduces error at very low bit width.
problems.theoryZh: 键异常值通常沿位置共享通道结构，而值异常值更适合按 token 局部处理。采用不同量化轴可降低极低比特下的误差。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
K(B,L,D) --min/max over L--> scale(B,1,D) -> quantize/dequantize
V(B,L,D) --min/max over D--> scale(B,L,1) -> quantize/dequantize
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
K(B,L,D) --沿 L 求 min/max--> scale(B,1,D) -> 量化/反量化
V(B,L,D) --沿 D 求 min/max--> scale(B,L,1) -> 量化/反量化
```

problems.title: PCA via SVD & Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) Trajectory Planner
problems.titleZh: SVD 主成分分析（PCA）与 CEM 交叉熵规划器
problems.hint: Center X and take the leading rows of Vh as principal axes. Negate costs before top-k so that the selected trajectories have the smallest original costs, then fit population mean and standard deviation.
problems.hintZh: 中心化 X，并取 Vh 的前几行作为主轴。top-k 前对代价取负以选择原始代价最小的轨迹，再拟合总体均值和标准差。
problems.descriptionEn: Project data X onto k_pca principal components obtained by compact SVD, and perform one CEM refitting step on the num_elites lowest-cost candidate action sequences.
problems.descriptionZh: 使用紧凑 SVD 得到的 k_pca 个主成分投影数据 X，并在代价最低的 num_elites 条候选动作序列上执行一次 CEM 重拟合。
problems.theoryEn: PCA finds orthogonal directions of maximal centered-data variation. CEM turns optimization into distribution fitting: retain low-cost elites and update each trajectory coordinate's Gaussian mean and scale.
problems.theoryZh: PCA 寻找中心化数据方差最大的正交方向。CEM 将优化转化为分布拟合：保留低代价精英，并更新轨迹各坐标的高斯均值与尺度。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
X -> center -> SVD -> leading Vh -> projected scores
candidate trajectories + costs -> lowest-cost elites -> mean,std
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
X -> 中心化 -> SVD -> Vh 前部 -> 投影分数
候选轨迹 + 代价 -> 最低代价精英 -> 均值、标准差
```

problems.title: Masked Diffusion LM (MDLM) Loss & Block-Causal Attention Mask
problems.titleZh: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）损失与块因果掩码
problems.hint: Compare integer block IDs to build the mask. Gather target log-probabilities, multiply by the continuous-time schedule weight and masked-position indicator, then normalize by the masked count.
problems.hintZh: 比较整数块编号构造掩码。收集目标对数概率，乘以连续时间调度权重和掩码位置指示，再按掩码数量归一化。
problems.descriptionEn: Construct an (S,S) block-causal attention mask and compute the continuous-time MDLM weighted cross-entropy over only masked tokens. Tokens attend bidirectionally within their block and to every earlier block.
problems.descriptionZh: 构造 (S,S) 块因果注意力掩码，并仅在被掩码 token 上计算连续时间 MDLM 加权交叉熵。token 在块内双向注意，并可注意所有更早块。
problems.theoryEn: Block diffusion decodes chunks in causal order while denoising each chunk bidirectionally. The schedule factor -alpha'(t)/(1-alpha(t)) is the continuous-time likelihood weighting for masked diffusion.
problems.theoryZh: 块扩散按因果顺序解码分块，同时在每个块内双向去噪。调度因子 -alpha'(t)/(1-alpha(t)) 是掩码扩散的连续时间似然权重。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
block 0: [<->]          visible
block 1: [past][<->]    visible
block 2: [past][past][<->]
masked NLL * (-alpha'/(1-alpha)) -> normalized loss
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
块 0：[双向]             可见
块 1：[过去][双向]       可见
块 2：[过去][过去][双向]
掩码 NLL * (-alpha'/(1-alpha)) -> 归一化损失
```

problems.title: Diffusion Min-SNR-Gamma Weighting & EDM Preconditioning
problems.titleZh: 扩散模型 Min-SNR-γ 损失加权与 EDM 预处理
problems.hint: Compute the schedule SNR first, cap it at gamma for the loss weight, and reuse sigma squared plus sigma_data squared for the EDM coefficients.
problems.hintZh: 先计算调度信噪比并将损失权重中的信噪比截断到 gamma，再复用 sigma 平方与 sigma_data 平方之和计算 EDM 系数。
problems.descriptionEn: Given cumulative signal retention alpha_bar_t and EDM noise levels sigma, return the Min-SNR-gamma loss weight followed by c_skip, c_out, c_in, and c_noise. Both inputs have shape (B,).
problems.descriptionZh: 给定累计信号保留率 alpha_bar_t 和 EDM 噪声水平 sigma，返回 Min-SNR-γ 损失权重以及 c_skip、c_out、c_in、c_noise。两个输入形状均为 (B,)。
problems.theoryEn: Min-SNR weighting prevents high-SNR timesteps from dominating diffusion training. EDM rescales the noisy input, residual output, skip path, and noise embedding according to sigma and the data standard deviation.
problems.theoryZh: Min-SNR 加权避免高信噪比时间步主导扩散训练。EDM 根据 sigma 与数据标准差缩放含噪输入、残差输出、跳连路径和噪声嵌入。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
alpha_bar -> SNR -> min(SNR,gamma)/SNR
sigma,sigma_data -> shared denominator -> c_skip,c_out,c_in,c_noise
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
alpha_bar -> SNR -> min(SNR,gamma)/SNR
sigma、sigma_data -> 公共分母 -> c_skip,c_out,c_in,c_noise
```

problems.titleZh: 相机深度图三维反投影与最远点采样（FPS）
problems.hint: Use an ij-indexed row/column meshgrid, flatten the stacked XYZ coordinates in row-major order, then repeatedly update each point's minimum squared distance to the selected set.
problems.hintZh: 使用 ij 索引的行列网格，将堆叠的 XYZ 坐标按行优先展平，再反复更新每个点到已选集合的最小平方距离。
problems.descriptionEn: Unproject an (H,W) pinhole-camera depth map into an (H*W,3) point cloud, then select num_samples point indices by deterministic iterative farthest point sampling starting at index zero.
problems.descriptionZh: 将 (H,W) 针孔相机深度图反投影为 (H*W,3) 点云，再从索引零开始用确定性的迭代最远点采样选择 num_samples 个点索引。
problems.theoryEn: Pinhole unprojection scales normalized image-plane rays by depth. FPS greedily maximizes coverage by choosing the point whose distance to its nearest selected point is largest.
problems.theoryZh: 针孔反投影用深度缩放归一化像平面射线。FPS 每次选择到最近已选点距离最大的点，从而贪心地扩大覆盖范围。

```text
index 0 -> update nearest distances -> argmax -> repeat
```

```text
索引 0 -> 更新最近距离 -> argmax -> 重复
```

problems.title: RLOO Leave-One-Out Advantage & PRM Step-Score Aggregation
problems.titleZh: RLOO 留一法优势估计与 PRM 步骤评分聚合
problems.hint: Compute all leave-one-out baselines from one row sum. For voting, use `torch.unique(..., return_inverse=True)` and scatter-add minimum trace scores into unique-answer bins.
problems.hintZh: 由一次行求和计算全部留一基线；投票时使用 `torch.unique(..., return_inverse=True)`，并将轨迹最小分数 scatter-add 到唯一答案桶中。
problems.descriptionEn: Compute grouped RLOO advantages, two process-reward trace aggregations, and a minimum-score-weighted Best-of-N answer vote.
problems.descriptionZh: 计算分组 RLOO 优势、两种过程奖励轨迹聚合，以及按最小步骤分数加权的 Best-of-N 答案投票。
problems.theoryEn: RLOO removes each sample from its own baseline to avoid self-influence. PRM minimum aggregation captures the weakest reasoning step, while the product captures cumulative confidence. Weighted voting combines evidence across traces sharing an answer.
problems.theoryZh: RLOO 从每个样本自身的基线中排除该样本，避免自影响。PRM 最小聚合捕捉最弱推理步骤，乘积聚合反映累积置信度；加权投票汇总相同答案的多条轨迹证据。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
group rewards -> row sum minus self -> LOO baseline -> advantage
step probabilities -> min & exp(sum(log))
trace min + answer id -> weighted bins -> argmax answer
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
组奖励 -> 行和减自身 -> 留一基线 -> 优势
步骤概率 -> min 与 exp(sum(log))
轨迹最小值 + 答案 ID -> 加权桶 -> 最大权重答案
```

problems.title: AWQ Salience Scaling & GPTQ Hessian Error Compensation
problems.titleZh: AWQ 激活显著度缩放与 GPTQ 黑塞误差补偿
problems.hint: AWQ uses mean absolute activation salience. For GPTQ, quantize one original W column and distribute its Hessian-normalized error only into columns to its right.
problems.hintZh: AWQ 使用激活绝对值均值作为显著度；GPTQ 量化 W 的一个原始列，并仅将黑塞归一化误差分配到其右侧列。
problems.descriptionEn: Perform AWQ channel scaling and one GPTQ/OBS column quantization step with inverse-Hessian error compensation.
problems.descriptionZh: 执行 AWQ 通道缩放，以及带逆黑塞误差补偿的一步 GPTQ/OBS 列量化。
problems.theoryEn: AWQ protects input channels with salient activations through a function-preserving weight/activation rescaling. GPTQ uses second-order curvature to compensate future columns for the error introduced by quantizing the current column.
problems.theoryZh: AWQ 通过保持函数不变的权重/激活反向缩放保护高显著度输入通道。GPTQ 使用二阶曲率，让后续列补偿当前列的量化误差。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
X -> mean |.| -> s -> W*s and X/s
W[:,q] -> round/clamp -> error/H_inv[q,q] -> compensate W[:,q+1:]
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
X -> |.| 均值 -> s -> W*s 与 X/s
W[:,q] -> 舍入/截断 -> 误差/H_inv[q,q] -> 补偿 W[:,q+1:]
```

problems.title: Chunkwise Parallel Causal Linear Attention
problems.titleZh: 分块并行因果线性注意力（Chunkwise Linear Attention）
problems.hint: Within each chunk, form all q-k dot products and multiply by a lower-triangular decay matrix. Add the decayed incoming-state read, then update the state with decayed outer products.
problems.hintZh: 在每个块内计算全部 q-k 点积并乘以下三角衰减矩阵，加上衰减后的输入状态读取，再用衰减外积更新状态。
problems.descriptionEn: Implement chunk-parallel causal linear attention whose outputs and final matrix state match the token-by-token decayed recurrence.
problems.descriptionZh: 实现分块并行因果线性注意力，使输出和最终矩阵状态与逐 token 衰减递推一致。
problems.theoryEn: The recurrent state summarizes all previous key-value outer products. Inside a chunk, associativity exposes a causal matrix multiplication, while powers of gamma preserve each token's exact recurrence age.
problems.theoryZh: 递归状态汇总此前所有键值外积。在块内，结合律将计算转化为因果矩阵乘法，而 gamma 的幂精确保留每个 token 的递推时距。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
incoming S --gamma^(i+1) reads--\
chunk Q,K -> causal decayed QK -> V -> outputs
chunk K,V -> terminal decay weights -> next S
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
输入 S --gamma^(i+1) 读取--\
块 Q,K -> 因果衰减 QK -> V -> 输出
块 K,V -> 末端衰减权重 -> 下一状态 S
```

problems.title: DeepSeek-V3 Sequential Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) Module
problems.titleZh: DeepSeek-V3 链式多 Token 预测（MTP）模块
problems.hint: RMS-normalize the two inputs independently, concatenate them, project back to the model dimension, and apply a stable mean cross-entropy over flattened positions.
problems.hintZh: 分别对两个输入进行 RMS 归一化，拼接后投影回模型维度，再对展平的位置计算数值稳定的平均交叉熵。
problems.descriptionEn: Implement one chained DeepSeek-V3 MTP depth: fuse the previous-depth representation with the shifted next-token embedding and predict the target at this depth.
problems.descriptionZh: 实现一层链式 DeepSeek-V3 MTP：融合前一深度表示与移位后的下一 token 嵌入，并预测该深度的目标。
problems.theoryEn: Sequential MTP reuses the representation from depth k-1. Separate RMSNorms balance the two streams before a learned fusion projection, while the shared unembedding head aligns every depth with the base vocabulary space.
problems.theoryZh: 链式 MTP 复用深度 k-1 的表示。独立 RMSNorm 在融合前平衡两路信号，共享反嵌入头使各深度都对齐到基础词表空间。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
h_(k-1) -> RMSNorm --\
                         concat -> W_proj -> h_k -> shared W_head -> logits -> CE
shifted embedding -> RMSNorm --/
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
h_(k-1) -> RMSNorm --\
                         拼接 -> W_proj -> h_k -> 共享 W_head -> logits -> CE
移位 token 嵌入 -> RMSNorm --/
```

problems.title: Flow-GRPO Reverse SDE Step & Velocity-Space KL
problems.titleZh: Flow-GRPO 逆向 SDE 采样步与速度场 KL
problems.hint: Build policy and detached-reference reverse drifts with the same scalar variance. Sample from the policy mean, detach that sample only inside its transition log probability, and use the equal-covariance Gaussian KL.
problems.hintZh: 用相同标量方差构造策略与分离参考速度的逆向漂移。从策略均值采样，仅在转移对数概率中分离样本，并使用同协方差高斯 KL。
problems.descriptionEn: Take one reverse SDE step from t to t-dt using policy velocity v_theta, evaluate its isotropic Gaussian transition log probability, and compute the closed-form KL to a transition induced by detached v_ref.
problems.descriptionZh: 使用策略速度 v_theta 从 t 到 t-dt 执行一步逆向 SDE，计算其各向同性高斯转移对数概率，并计算与分离 v_ref 所诱导转移之间的闭式 KL。
problems.theoryEn: The stochastic transition has covariance g(t)^2 dt I. Equal policy and reference covariance reduces KL to half the squared mean displacement divided by the scalar variance. Detaching the sampled target gives a score-function-style log-probability gradient.
problems.theoryZh: 随机转移协方差为 g(t)^2 dt I。策略与参考协方差相同时，KL 化为均值差平方除以标量方差的一半。分离采样目标可得到类似得分函数的对数概率梯度。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
(x_t,v_theta) -> reverse drift -> mean + std*noise -> x_next -> log_prob
(x_t,stopgrad(v_ref)) -> reference mean ---------> equal-variance KL
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
(x_t,v_theta) -> 逆漂移 -> 均值 + std*噪声 -> x_next -> log_prob
(x_t,stopgrad(v_ref)) -> 参考均值 -------------> 同方差 KL
```

tests.name: exact transition reference

import torch, math
x=torch.tensor([[1.,-2.]]); vt=torch.tensor([[.3,.4]]); vr=torch.tensor([[-.2,.1]]); n=torch.tensor([[.5,-1.]])
t=.6; dt=.05; sa=.7; eps=1e-6
xn,lp,kl={fn}(x,vt,vr,t,dt,n,sa,eps)
g2=sa**2*t/(1-t+eps); drift=vt+g2/(2*t)*(x+(1-t)*vt); mean=x-dt*drift
ref=x-dt*(vr+g2/(2*t)*(x+(1-t)*vr))
rx=mean+math.sqrt(g2*dt)*n
rlp=-.5*(((rx.detach()-mean)**2)/(g2*dt+eps)+math.log(2*math.pi*g2*dt)).sum(-1)
rkl=(.5*(mean-ref)**2/(g2*dt+eps)).sum(-1)
assert torch.equal(xn,rx) and torch.equal(lp,rlp) and torch.equal(kl,rkl)

problems.title: JEPA Latent Prediction & VICReg Anti-Collapse Regularization
problems.titleZh: JEPA 潜空间预测与 VICReg 防坍缩正则损失
problems.hint: Detach the target for invariance. Compute population standard deviation for the variance hinge, but divide the centered Gram matrix by B-1 for covariance and remove its diagonal.
problems.hintZh: 在不变性项中分离目标。方差铰链使用总体标准差，但协方差用中心化 Gram 矩阵除以 B-1，并移除对角线。
problems.descriptionEn: Combine detached-target JEPA prediction MSE with VICReg variance and covariance anti-collapse penalties for latent batches pred_z and target_z of shape (B,D), with B at least two.
problems.descriptionZh: 对形状为 (B,D)、B 至少为 2 的潜变量批次 pred_z 和 target_z，将分离目标的 JEPA 预测 MSE 与 VICReg 方差、协方差防坍缩惩罚结合。
problems.theoryEn: Invariance aligns predictions to target representations. A standard-deviation hinge prevents constant features, while squared off-diagonal covariance discourages redundant dimensions without forcing individual samples apart.
problems.theoryZh: 不变性项将预测对齐目标表示；标准差铰链防止恒定特征，非对角协方差平方则抑制冗余维度，而无需强制分离单个样本。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
pred,target(stopgrad) -> invariance MSE
pred -> per-dim std hinge + off-diagonal covariance -> total weighted loss
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
预测、目标(stopgrad) -> 不变性 MSE
预测 -> 逐维标准差铰链 + 非对角协方差 -> 加权总损失
```

problems.title: MLA Decoupled RoPE & Weight Matrix Absorption
problems.titleZh: MLA 解耦 RoPE 与矩阵吸收推理
problems.hint: Move the per-head key up-projection onto the content query, score the compressed cache directly, aggregate in latent space, and apply the value up-projection only after attention.
problems.hintZh: 把逐头键上投影吸收到内容查询中，直接对压缩缓存打分，在潜空间聚合后再应用值上投影。
problems.descriptionEn: Implement MLA inference with decoupled positional keys and matrix absorption, avoiding materialization of full per-head K and V caches.
problems.descriptionZh: 实现带解耦位置键和矩阵吸收的 MLA 推理，避免物化完整的逐头 K、V 缓存。
problems.theoryEn: Associativity lets q(W_uk)^T be evaluated before interaction with the compressed latent. Likewise, attention can aggregate compressed values first and apply W_uv afterward. The separate RoPE branch preserves positional information.
problems.theoryZh: 利用结合律，可在压缩潜变量交互前先计算 q(W_uk)^T；同理可先聚合压缩值，再应用 W_uv。独立 RoPE 分支保留位置信息。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
q_nope -> absorb W_uk -> score c_kv --\
q_rope -----------------> score k_rope -> softmax -> aggregate c_kv -> W_uv -> out
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
q_nope -> 吸收 W_uk -> 对 c_kv 打分 --\
q_rope -----------------> 对 k_rope 打分 -> softmax -> 聚合 c_kv -> W_uv -> 输出
```

tests.name: exact absorbed reference
tests.code:
import torch
import math
torch.manual_seed(4)
B,H,Q,K,C,D,R,V = 1,2,3,4,3,2,2,3
qn = torch.randn(B,H,Q,D,dtype=torch.double); qr = torch.randn(B,H,Q,R,dtype=torch.double)
c = torch.randn(B,K,C,dtype=torch.double); kr = torch.randn(B,K,R,dtype=torch.double)
wk = torch.randn(H,C,D,dtype=torch.double); wv = torch.randn(H,C,V,dtype=torch.double)
out, qa = {fn}(qn,qr,c,kr,wk,wv)
rqa = torch.einsum('bhqd,hcd->bhqc',qn,wk)
scores = (torch.einsum('bhqc,bkc->bhqk',rqa,c)+torch.einsum('bhqr,bkr->bhqk',qr,kr))/math.sqrt(D+R)
a = torch.softmax(scores,-1); ro = torch.einsum('bhqc,hcv->bhqv',torch.einsum('bhqk,bkc->bhqc',a,c),wv)
assert torch.allclose(qa,rqa,atol=1e-12,rtol=1e-12)
assert torch.allclose(out,ro,atol=1e-12,rtol=1e-12)

problems.title: Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) & Expert-Choice Routing
problems.titleZh: 混合深度路由（MoD）与专家选择路由（Expert-Choice）
problems.hint: Scatter each batch row's MoD top-k indices into a boolean mask. Separately softmax router logits over experts, transpose, and let every expert run its own top-k.
problems.hintZh: 将每个批次行的 MoD top-k 索引散射成布尔掩码；另对路由 logit 按专家做 softmax、转置，并让每位专家独立执行 top-k。
problems.descriptionEn: Combine token-level depth skipping with expert-choice routing, returning gated residual outputs and each expert's selected tokens and scores.
problems.descriptionZh: 结合 token 级深度跳过与专家选择路由，返回门控残差输出以及每位专家选择的 token 和分数。
problems.theoryEn: MoD limits expensive block computation by selecting tokens, while preserving an identity residual for bypassed positions. Expert-choice reverses token-choice routing: experts claim their highest-probability tokens under fixed capacity.
problems.theoryZh: MoD 通过选择 token 限制昂贵模块的计算，并让跳过位置保持恒等残差。专家选择路由反转 token 选择：每位专家在固定容量下挑选概率最高的 token。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
mod logits -> sigmoid -> per-batch top-k -> gated FFN residual
router logits -> softmax over experts -> transpose -> per-expert top-k tokens
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
深度 logit -> sigmoid -> 逐批 top-k -> 门控 FFN 残差
专家 logit -> 按专家 softmax -> 转置 -> 每位专家 top-k token
```

tests.name: exact MoD and expert reference
tests.code:
import torch
x = torch.arange(24.,dtype=torch.double).reshape(2,4,3)
f = torch.ones_like(x)*2
m = torch.tensor([[0.,3.,-2.,1.],[4.,-1.,2.,0.]],dtype=torch.double)
r = torch.tensor([[3.,0.],[0.,2.],[1.,1.],[2.,-1.]],dtype=torch.double)
out, tok, val = {fn}(x,m,f,r,2)
w = torch.sigmoid(m); idx = torch.topk(w,2,-1).indices
mask = torch.zeros_like(w,dtype=torch.bool).scatter(1,idx,True)
ref = x + mask.unsqueeze(-1)*w.unsqueeze(-1)*f
p = torch.softmax(r,-1); rv,rt = torch.topk(p.T,2,-1)
assert torch.equal(out,ref) and torch.equal(tok,rt) and torch.equal(val,rv)

problems.title: Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) Asymmetric Cross-Modal Attention
problems.titleZh: Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 非对称跨模态注意力
problems.hint: Concatenate both streams, then combine a causal lower-triangular AR query block with an all-true diffusion query block. Use the boolean mask before softmax.
problems.hintZh: 先拼接两条流，再将 AR 查询的因果下三角块与全真的扩散查询块组合，在 softmax 前应用布尔掩码。
problems.descriptionEn: Compute single-head scaled dot-product attention over concatenated autoregressive and diffusion streams. AR queries are causal and cannot read diffusion tokens; diffusion queries can read every token. Return both split outputs and the boolean mask.
problems.descriptionZh: 在拼接的自回归流和扩散流上计算单头缩放点积注意力。AR 查询具有因果性且不能读取扩散 token；扩散查询可读取所有 token。返回拆分输出和布尔掩码。
problems.theoryEn: The asymmetric mask protects autoregressive generation from future and diffusion information while exposing the complete reasoner context to the bidirectional diffusion generator.
problems.theoryZh: 非对称掩码保护自回归生成不接触未来及扩散信息，同时向双向扩散生成器开放完整推理器上下文。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
keys:     AR          DM
AR q:   causal      blocked
DM q:   all visible all visible
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
键：       AR          DM
AR 查询： 因果可见      禁止
DM 查询： 全部可见      全部可见
```

problems.title: Multimodal 3D Rotary Position Embedding (M-RoPE)
problems.titleZh: 多模态三维旋转位置编码（M-RoPE）
problems.hint: Split each embedding into temporal, height, and width sections. For each section, build half as many frequencies and rotate adjacent even/odd coordinate pairs before concatenating.
problems.hintZh: 将嵌入拆分为时间、高度和宽度三段。每段构造一半数量的频率，旋转相邻偶数/奇数坐标对后再拼接。
problems.descriptionEn: Apply axis-specific rotary embeddings to q and k of shape (B,S,D), using per-token temporal, height, and width coordinates in pos_3d and even section dimensions summing to D.
problems.descriptionZh: 对形状为 (B,S,D) 的 q 和 k 应用分轴旋转位置编码，使用 pos_3d 中逐 token 的时间、高度、宽度坐标；三个偶数段维度之和为 D。
problems.theoryEn: RoPE represents position by orthogonal rotations of adjacent feature pairs. M-RoPE allocates disjoint channel sections to independent temporal and spatial coordinates, retaining norm while encoding three-dimensional relative phase.
problems.theoryZh: RoPE 通过相邻特征对的正交旋转表示位置。M-RoPE 将互不重叠的通道段分配给时间和空间坐标，在保持范数的同时编码三维相对相位。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
features -> [temporal | height | width]
positions -> [t rotation | h rotation | w rotation] -> concatenate
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
特征 -> [时间段 | 高度段 | 宽度段]
坐标 -> [t 旋转 | h 旋转 | w 旋转] -> 拼接
```

import torch
q=torch.arange(1.,13.).reshape(1,1,12); k=-q; p=torch.tensor([[[1.,2.,3.]]]); dims=(2,4,6); base=100.
qr,kr={fn}(q,k,p,dims,base)
def rot(x,d,pos):
 f=1/(base**(torch.arange(0,d,2).float()/d)); a=pos*f
 e=x[...,0::2]; o=x[...,1::2]
 return torch.stack((e*torch.cos(a)-o*torch.sin(a),e*torch.sin(a)+o*torch.cos(a)),-1).flatten(-2)
parts=torch.split(q,dims,-1); ref=torch.cat([rot(parts[i],dims[i],p[...,i:i+1]) for i in range(3)],-1)
assert torch.equal(qr,ref) and torch.equal(kr,-ref)

problems.title: QLoRA NF4 Codebook & Double Quantization
problems.titleZh: QLoRA NF4 分位数码本与双重量化
problems.hint: Normalize each flattened block by its absmax and use a broadcasted distance to all 16 codebook entries. Then quantize the vector of absmax values with one global 8-bit scale.
problems.hintZh: 用各展平块的绝对值最大值归一化，并广播计算到 16 个码本值的距离；随后用一个全局 8 位尺度量化 absmax 向量。
problems.descriptionEn: Quantize weights blockwise to a 16-entry NF4 codebook, then double-quantize the block scales and reconstruct the dequantized tensor.
problems.descriptionZh: 按块将权重量化到 16 项 NF4 码本，再双重量化块尺度并重建反量化张量。
problems.theoryEn: NF4 allocates its levels to a distribution suited to normally distributed weights. Double quantization reduces metadata cost by quantizing the per-block absmax values themselves.
problems.theoryZh: NF4 将量化级分配给适合近似正态权重的分布。双重量化进一步量化逐块 absmax，从而降低元数据开销。
problems.diagramEn:
```text
W -> flat blocks -> /absmax -> nearest NF4 index
absmax -> /c2 -> int8 levels -> dequantized absmax -> reconstruct W
```
problems.diagramZh:
```text
W -> 展平分块 -> /absmax -> 最近 NF4 索引
absmax -> /c2 -> int8 级别 -> 反量化 absmax -> 重建 W
```

tests.name: exact two-level reference

import torch
cb = torch.tensor([-1.,-.8,-.6,-.45,-.3,-.2,-.1,0.,.08,.16,.25,.4,.55,.7,.85,1.],dtype=torch.double)
W = torch.tensor([[1.,-.7,.2,0.],[-2.,.9,-.4,.1]],dtype=torch.double)
idx, qa, c2, deq = {fn}(W,cb,block_size=4,eps=1e-12)
b = W.reshape(-1,4); a = b.abs().amax(-1).clamp(min=1e-12)
ri = torch.argmin((b.div(a[:,None]).unsqueeze(-1)-cb).abs(),-1)
rc = a.abs().max().clamp(min=1e-12)/127.; rq = torch.clamp(torch.round(a/rc),-127.,127.)
rd = (cb[ri]*(rq*rc)[:,None]).reshape_as(W)
assert torch.equal(idx,ri.reshape_as(W)) and torch.equal(qa,rq)
assert torch.equal(c2,rc) and torch.equal(deq,rd)
